↑.name: natural succ
↑.plain: a ↑ is a + 1 for a nonnegative integer; negative inputs give NaN.
↑.plain_zh: a ↑ 是非负整数 a 加一，负数输入得 NaN。

↓.name: natural pred
↓.plain: a ↓ is max(0, a - 1) for a nonnegative integer; negative inputs give NaN.
↓.plain_zh: a ↓ 是 max(0, a - 1)，负数输入得 NaN。

○.name: is zero
○.plain: a ○ is 1 when a is zero and 0 otherwise; negative inputs give NaN.
○.plain_zh: a ○ 在 a 为零时得 1，否则得 0，负数输入得 NaN。
